title: Log in to access the admin dashboard
description: This test verifies that an administrator can sign in and reach the protected admin dashboard.

steps.description: Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify the admin dashboard is displayed

title: Block access to the admin dashboard before login
description: This test verifies that an unauthenticated visitor is not allowed to open the protected admin dashboard.

steps.description: Verify access to the admin dashboard is blocked
Verify the login page or access restriction message is displayed

title: Sign in to the administrator dashboard
description: An administrator can log in with valid credentials and reach the protected dashboard.

steps.description: Verify the user lands on the administration dashboard

title: Browse the public home page to institutional pages
description: This test verifies that a visitor can move from the home page to key institutional pages and back through the shared navigation.

steps.description: Click the link to the institutional information page
Verify the institutional information page is displayed
Click the link to return to the home page
Click the link to the admissions information page
Verify the admissions information page is displayed

title: Search the site and open a matching result
description: This test verifies that a visitor can search across site content and open a matching result from the search page.

steps.description: Fill in the search field with curso
Verify matching search results are displayed

title: Open a course detail from the catalog
description: This test verifies that a visitor can open a course from the catalog and view its details.

steps.description: Open a course detail page from the catalog
Verify the course detail page is displayed

title: Load the course catalog when the page opens
description: This test verifies that the course catalog page shows available courses when opened directly.

steps.description: Verify the course list is displayed

title: Filter the course catalog by search term and filters
description: This test verifies that a visitor can narrow the course catalog using a search term, technological area, and shift.

steps.description: Fill in the course search field with a valid search term
Verify the filtered course results are displayed

title: Access the protected dashboard only after signing in
description: An unauthenticated visitor trying to open the admin dashboard is kept out until signing in successfully.

steps.description: Verify access is restricted from the protected dashboard
Verify the user lands on the administration dashboard

title: Search the site for a known topic and open a result
description: This test verifies that a visitor can use site search to find relevant content and continue browsing from a result page.

steps.description: Verify the matching content page is displayed

title: Use the shared navigation to reach course, news, and document pages
description: This test verifies that a visitor can use the shared navigation to open the main content sections of the site.

steps.description: Click the link to the courses catalog
Verify the course catalog is displayed
Click the link to the news page
Verify the news page is displayed
Click the link to the documents page
Verify the documents page is displayed

title: View full course information and approved evaluations
description: This test verifies that a visitor can read a course page and review its published details and evaluations.

steps.description: Open a course detail page from the catalog
Scroll to the course details section
Verify course curriculum and entry requirements are displayed

title: Open the contact page from the public navigation
description: This test verifies that a visitor can reach the contact page from the shared site navigation.

steps.description: Click the link to the contact page
Verify the contact information page is displayed

title: Compare two courses and review the results
description: This test verifies that a visitor can select two courses and view a side-by-side comparison of their differences.

steps.description: Verify the comparison results are displayed

title: Use the student area to submit an evaluation
description: This test verifies that a current student or alumni can submit a course evaluation from the student area and receive confirmation.

steps.description: Fill in the evaluation form with valid information
Verify a submission confirmation is visible

title: Submit a course evaluation successfully
description: A current student or alumni can complete the evaluation form and receive submission feedback after sending a valid evaluation.

steps.description: Fill in the evaluation form with valid information
Verify a submission confirmation is visible
Verify the submitted evaluation is reflected in the feedback area

title: Review and approve a pending evaluation
description: An administrator can open pending evaluations in the dashboard and approve one so it is no longer pending.

steps.description: Verify the evaluation is no longer pending
Verify the updated moderation state is displayed

title: Adjust the catalog search to update the results
description: This test verifies that a visitor can change or clear a catalog search and see the course list update accordingly.

steps.description: Fill in the course search field with a valid search term
Verify the broader course list is displayed

title: Update search terms and see refreshed results
description: This test verifies that changing the search query updates the visible search results on the site search page.

steps.description: Fill in the search field with documento
Verify updated search results are displayed
Verify the previous results are no longer displayed

title: Open the news and documents pages from the public site
description: This test verifies that a visitor can browse from the public site to the news and documents sections.

steps.description: Click the link to the news page
Verify the news page is displayed
Click the link to the documents page
Verify the documents page is displayed

title: Submit a testimonial successfully
description: A current student or alumni can switch to testimonial mode, complete the form, and receive confirmation that the testimonial was sent for moderation.

steps.description: Fill in the testimonial form with valid information
Verify a submission confirmation is visible
Verify the testimonial submission feedback is displayed

title: Browse news and open a publication
description: This test verifies that a visitor can browse published news items and open one to read its details.

steps.description: Verify the news item details are displayed
Verify published news content is visible

title: Create or edit published content from the dashboard
description: An administrator can create or edit news or document content and see the saved changes reflected in the dashboard.

steps.description: Open the content editor for news or documents
Verify the saved content appears in the dashboard
Verify the edited content state is displayed

title: Browse documents and open a published file entry
description: This test verifies that a visitor can view published documents and open a document or notice from the documents page.

steps.description: Verify the document details are displayed
Verify published documents content is visible

title: Log out of the administrator dashboard
description: An authenticated administrator can sign out and return to the login page.

steps.description: Verify the administrator login page is displayed
Verify the dashboard session is no longer available

title: Reject invalid administrator credentials
description: A user entering invalid administrator credentials sees an authentication error and cannot access the dashboard.

steps.description: Fill in administrator email with invalid@example.com
Fill in administrator password with invalid-password
Verify an authentication error is visible
Verify the administration dashboard is not displayed

title: Show validation when submitting an incomplete evaluation
description: This test verifies that the student evaluation form blocks submission and shows validation feedback when required information is missing.

steps.description: Submit the evaluation form without completing required fields
Verify a validation error is visible

title: Move from news to documents while browsing publications
description: This test verifies that a visitor can continue browsing institutional publications by moving from the news page to the documents page.

steps.description: Verify the documents page content is visible

title: Delete managed content after confirmation
description: An administrator can delete a managed item from the dashboard and confirm that it is removed from the admin list.

steps.description: Delete managed content when controls are available
Verify the content item is removed from the list
Verify the deletion result is displayed

title: See comparison guidance when not enough courses are selected
description: This test verifies that the comparison page handles incomplete selection by showing guidance instead of comparison results.

steps.description: Verify a selection guidance message is displayed
Verify comparison results are not displayed

title: Reject invalid admin credentials
description: This test verifies that the admin login form shows an error when incorrect credentials are submitted.

steps.description: Fill in the username field with invalid-user
Fill in the password field with invalid-password
Verify a login error is visible

title: Show validation feedback for missing required evaluation data
description: A user who submits the evaluation form without required information sees validation feedback and the form is not accepted.

steps.description: Submit the form without completing the required fields
Verify a validation error is visible
Verify the form remains available for correction

title: See an empty search state for an unmatched query
description: This test verifies that the site search page shows an empty state when a query has no matching results.

steps.description: Fill in the search field with zzzzzz
Verify an empty state message is displayed
Verify no search results are displayed

title: Handle an empty course search result
description: This test verifies that the course catalog shows an empty state when a search term returns no matches.

steps.description: Fill in the course search field with a rare search term
Verify an empty state message is visible
